brand.name: TASNED INTEGRATED
promises: Protecting our oceans. Ensuring compliance. Delivering solutions.
Integrity. Innovation. Responsibility. For oceans. For tomorrow.

theme_strategy.description: Base is pristine, clinical white (laboratory feel) with immersive deep navy sections (oceanic depth). Cyan serves as the kinetic/technical accent.

rules.h1: text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-navy leading-none
rules.label: text-xs md:text-sm font-accent tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-teal

spacing_and_layout.rtl_support: Use logical properties (ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, text-start, text-end, border-s). Add dir='rtl' toggle logic in standard layout wrapper.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion (initial y: 100%, opacity: 0 -> animate y: 0, opacity: 1, staggerChildren).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with increased shadow. Text/Icon colors transition to Cyan.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform for subtle y-axis parallax on hero ocean background.

Home: Kinetic Hero: Deep navy background, subtle parallax ocean texture overlay (opacity-20). Large masked typography reveal. Primary CTA.
Editorial Marquee: 'Protecting our oceans • Ensuring compliance • Delivering solutions' scrolling infinitely.
Services Bento Grid: 7 services. Light gray/white cards with hover effects.
Why Choose TASNED: Numbered manifesto chapters with JetBrains Mono numerals.
Animated Counters: Vessels inspected, Samples analyzed, Ports served.
About: Story, Vision/Mission, Team, Accreditations (DNV, SGS, Bureau Veritas benchmarks).
Services: Detailing Ballast Water Testing, Laboratory Analysis, Marine Environmental Testing. 5-step Testing Workflow visual (Timeline style).
Standards: IMO D-1/D-2, USCG compliance details. Technical tables.
News: Grid of articles. Admin panel for CRUD operations.
Contact: Detailed inspection request form (Name, Company, Email, Phone, Vessel Name, IMO Number, Port, Requested Service, Preferred Date, Message). Google Map placeholder. Business Hours.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis (or lenis), react-fast-marquee, lucide-react.
Load Montserrat and JetBrains Mono fonts from Google Fonts.
Implement a persistent Navigation bar with EN/AR toggle. For RTL, ensure 'dir=rtl' changes the document direction and tailwind logical properties handle the rest.
DO NOT use generic purple/pink AI gradients. Stick STRICTLY to the Navy/Teal/Cyan/White palette.
Ensure the hero section uses the 'hero_ocean_texture' image with a very dark overlay (bg-navy/80 or bg-black/60) so the kinetic text is legible.
Build the 5-step Testing Workflow as a vertical or horizontal connected timeline using framer-motion for scroll-triggered line drawing.
For the Contact Form, use Shadcn Form elements and ensure all requested fields are present.
Admin Panel: Build a simple mock-CRUD interface for News under a specific route (e.g., /admin/news).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Always use modern button styles, matching the brand (e.g., Navy or Cyan background, white text, subtle hover lift).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap. Use py-24 for main sections.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
